notes: Surviving Acropolis architectural ensemble: native Parthenon with mapped surviving column/capital/wall and pediment-fragment controls, roofless Erechtheion with six modern Caryatid replicas/Ionic porches, Propylaea open monumental entrance and wings, roofless Athena Nike temple on built bastion, Beulé Gate/steps and Agrippa pedestal, intrinsic stone fortifications and low Roma/Augustus circular remains. Include lower-slope Odeon of Herodes Atticus surviving perforated stage wall/open seating, Theatre of Dionysus surviving lower stone seats/orchestra and Stoa of Eumenes ruined retaining arcade. No natural rock/hill/precinct slab, lost Hekatompedon (reserved hekatompedon_temple), conjectural Old Temple of Athena/Older Parthenon, vanished Frankish/Ottoman buildings, modern worksheds/museum/church/lifts/scaffolds/visitors or unrelated Athens structures.
